title: Local Frobenius under pullback of constructible rational Weil sheaves
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ of characteristic $p$, an algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a morphism of separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes, and let $f:X_0\times_{k_0}k\to Y_0\times_{k_0}k$ be its base change. Use the common-stage rational coefficient categories and constructible Weil sheaves of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], and derived pullback of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. For every constructible $\Qlb$-Weil sheaf $\mathcal F$ on $Y_0$, the pullback $Lf^*\mathcal F$, with its induced Weil structure, lies in the constructible heart. Write it as $f^*\mathcal F$. For every closed point $z\in X_0$, the point $x=f_0(z)$ is closed, $\kappa(x)\subset\kappa(z)$ is a finite extension of positive degree $e$, and $q_z=q_x^e$, where $q_t=\#\kappa(t)$. For compatible geometric points there is a natural $\Qlb$-linear isomorphism
$$c_{f,z}:(f^*\mathcal F)_{\bar z}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal F_{\bar x},\qquad c_{f,z}F_{z,f^*\mathcal F}=F_{x,\mathcal F}^{\,e}c_{f,z},$$
where the local operators are geometric Frobenius as in [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]. In particular the eigenvalue multiset at $z$ is $\{\alpha^e:\alpha\in\operatorname{Eig}(F_{x,\mathcal F})\}$, with algebraic multiplicities.
